title: [Roadmap] 2026 Q3 vLLM × RL
body:
## 1. State Transitions / Context Switch

The RL training loop requires the inference engine to cycle between states (sleeping ↔ awake, paused ↔ running, old weights ↔ new weights, stale KV ↔ fresh KV). Each transition must be correct, fast, and memory-efficient.

### 1.1 Weight Update

**Anchor RFC**: [#31848](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/31848) 

### 1.2 Scheduler (Sleep/Wake/Drain)

**Anchor RFC**: [#48311](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48311)

## 2. RL Information Retrieval

**Anchor RFC**: [#48306](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48306)

- **RL Dev API**: 
- **Weight Version Tagging**
- **Runtime Data Endpoints**


## 3. Consistency

**Anchor RFC**: [#48305](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/48305)

Training-inference consistency: same sample + same weights + same routing → trainer and rollout engine observe identical results. Six sources of divergence:

- **3.1 Logprobs & Token-ID Replay**
- **3.2 R3 Routing Replay**
- **3.3 DSA Index Replay**
- **3.4 Data Plane**: artifact transfer connector 
- **3.5 Hidden States Replay**
- **3.6 Dtype Replay**


## 4. Feature Enablement

New RL capabilities that extend vLLM's feature surface for training frameworks.

### 4.1 Adaptive Two-Phase Performance Profile
